suites.name: Contract and descriptor
suites.contents: Schema validation, cross-SDK descriptor fixtures, package archive checks, the three SDK descriptor tests, route analysis, error model mapping, digest rules and library composition
suites.runsWhen: Every commit touching contracts, the packager or SDK generators

suites.name: SDK unit
suites.contents: Per-language annotations, generators, runtime, context accessors and the local dev server

suites.name: Protocol compatibility
suites.contents: Tool protocol stdin v1 and v2, MCP 2026-07-28 core and the legacy adapter per supported version, the Tasks extension, launcher and protocol-range handshakes
suites.runsWhen: Every Gateway, Tool Host, client or SDK release, and PRs touching protocol code
suites.runner: gateway, tool-host, endpoint-client and SDK test trees

suites.name: Security and authorisation
suites.contents: Credentials and IdP templates, delegation, permits, catalog scope, broker channel, egress, service-profile deltas, business keys, effect class, kill merge, namespaces, transports, and every Tool Host threat-model case
suites.runsWhen: Every PR touching auth, Gateway policy, broker or egress, ledger or reservation, kill switch, or packaging trust

suites.name: Integration and failure injection
suites.contents: Duplicate execution, effect semantics and reconcile, break-glass propagation, rollout, delta corruption, OpenAPI import, every persistence transition and its failure case
suites.runsWhen: CI on main, plus every release candidate

suites.name: Mode equivalence
suites.contents: Every example and fixture in standalone and governed modes with the same inputs, plus startup refusals

suites.name: Official MCP SDK compatibility
suites.contents: modelcontextprotocol/conformance plus ToolGate MRTR, Tasks and identity cases against each pinned official SDK

suites.name: Multi-host chaos and load
suites.contents: Gateway and Tool Host partitions, store failover, kill propagation timing, warm-pool isolation under load, polling and socket scale

suites.name: Full language matrix
suites.contents: Every SDK across supported language versions, operating systems and Tool Host and client versions
